posts.author: RPGMakerUser4001
posts.body:
The issue I have is this: I'd like to have my game scale up as much as possible on the users screen without causing any distortion. So essentially, what having the option 'allow stretch scaling' set to false does. However, my project's assets are already scaled up by 2x.
In order to have the project scale as much as it can without distortion, I'd need the plugin to be able to scale not just to 1x, 2x, 3x, etc but to 1x, 1.5x, 2x, 2.5x etc, because of my already 2x assets.
Might anyone know how to achieve this? I'm not too knowledgeable in the subject so I'd appreciate as much help as you can offer.

posts.author: Eliaquim
posts.body:
Hi there!
If you are mentioning a plugin, always set their link on your post, so people can take a look at it. This will help you being helped by others.
Pixel Perfect for RPG Maker MV/MZ by Galenmereth
A free pay-if-you-want plugin for RPG Maker MV and MZ that enables pixel-perfect scaling mode
galenmereth.itch.io
Using the plugin and set the Stretch to false when fullscreen should do the trick. Unless you don't have a pixel perfect game resolution. Both width and height must be multiple of your assets size. For example, if you use a 32x32 tileset, 720/32 = 22.5. Not a good resolution.
But if your tileset is 48x48: 720/48 = 15. So you should be fine.
At least on my tests, with my plugins I did manage to achieve a pixel perfect following that logic. maybe some artist can have a better input than mine.
